# Bid the suction, the membrane, and the circuit.

> Price a radon mitigation install from extra suction points, crawl membrane, roof discharge, high-suction fan, new circuit, firestops, permit, and post-mitigation test — not a published $1,195 radon special. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper basement quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
